description: Figure 3 is a donut chart illustrating the distribution of different types of input stimulus material provided by journalists to large language models (LLMs) in the WildChat conversations that were matched to online articles from two news agencies. The chart is segmented into eight categories, each with a distinct color and labeled with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, representing 26.4% of the total, is "Draft/Other," shown in a dark red color. The second largest is "Press Release" at 18.7%, depicted in yellow. "External News Article" accounts for 18.1% and is shown in a dark green. "Interview" makes up 8.8% and is colored purple. "Event Posting" is 6.6% and is shown in a light purple. "Organizational Report" is 7.7% and is colored a medium green. "Organizational Website" and "Intra-agency news article" are both 4.9% and are shown in a light blue and a very light blue, respectively. "Email" is 2.7% and is colored a light green, while "Social Media Post" is the smallest segment at 1.1% and is shown in a very light red. The chart is titled "Stimulus Type" in the center.
